repairs.description: If Matthew and Luke reuse Mark, while John knows the Synoptics, the Gospels represent one dependent tradition stream rather than four independent witnesses.
repairs.rationale: Combines the stated literary dependence with its evidential consequence in one complete sentence without adding evidence.

repairs.description: God remains continuously present as justice rather than intermittently violating nature; Jesus's forgiveness from the cross therefore manifests divinity more meaningfully than miraculous physical passage.
repairs.rationale: Preserves the contrast between continuous divine presence and supernatural intervention while stating Crossan's comparative inference as a complete sentence.
